name: Worldforged Wailing Talisman has its second Winterspring pickup back (#6508)
contract: The pre-realm-map Worldforged data recorded two distinct Wailing Talisman pickups (entry 518565, item 410095) in Winterspring: guid 6904931 at map 1 (6444.900, -4290.200, 663.0291) and guid 6904932 at (6413.100, -4299.800, 663.7570), 33.22 yd apart. The realm-map pass retained only the second as guid 6942396, leaving nothing within reach of the reported position (6449.1816, -4278.8457, 666.7479). The fix restores guid 6904931 at its recorded placement. A phase-1 player at the reported position sees exactly one entry-518565 pickup, opens it with Opening (3365) from its own spot and loots item 410095, while the retained pickup still stands at (6413.100, -4299.800).

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: one Wailing Talisman pickup near the reported position
the pickup is within reach and opens
its loot holds the Wailing Talisman
